name: [R17] Nginx worker crash pattern consistent with ngx_http_rewrite_module overflow (CVE-2026-42945, "NGINX Rift")
message:
Traffic/logs match indicators of CVE-2026-42945 ("NGINX Rift", CVSS 9.2): an 18-year-old heap-based buffer overflow in ngx_http_rewrite_module affecting NGINX Open Source 0.6.27-1.30.0 and NGINX Plus R32-R36. A single crafted HTTP request can crash worker processes pre-auth; with ASLR disabled, RCE is possible. Exploitation attempts were reported shortly after public disclosure (2026-05).

Either a worker-crash signature (signal 11/SIGSEGV or signal 6) or a Server header still advertising a pre-1.30.1 version is a lead, not proof -- confirm against the exact installed nginx version and, for exploitability (not just patch status), whether nginx.conf uses the specific vulnerable rewrite-directive pattern (unnamed PCRE capture + '?' in the replacement + a following rewrite/if/set in the same scope).

Tune: sites running with server_tokens off will never match the version-based case -- rely on the crash-pattern case instead. Fixed versions: NGINX OSS 1.31.0 / 1.30.1, NGINX Plus R36 P4 / R35 P2 / R32 P6.

queries.name: nginx_worker_crash
queries.query: source:nginx (@message:*"worker process exited on signal 11"* OR @message:*"worker process exited on signal 6"* OR @message:*SIGSEGV*)

cases.name: Pre-1.30.1 nginx version header observed (leads-generator only)
